column1: TABLE 1. Species averages for life-history variables. Column headings refer to: (1) Female weight in kg; (2) Male weight in kg; (3) Gestation length in days; (4) Weight of individual neonates in g; (5) Number of offspring per litter; (6) Weaning age in days; (7) Length of estrous cycle in days; (8) Age at first breeding for females in months; (9) Age at sexual maturity for females in months; (10) Maximum recorded lifespan in years; (11) Interbirth interval in days; (12) Age at sexual maturity for males in months; (13) Neonatal brain weight in grams; (14) Adult brain weight in grams.
